newsitem.title: CANADA: CanOxy gets Wascana Energy shares.
newsitem.headline: CanOxy gets Wascana Energy shares.

text.p: Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd. said on Monday that over two-thirds of Wascana Energy Inc.'s shares -- not including those it already held -- had been tendered to its C$2-billion takeover offer.
The offer, which expires at midnight Pacific time (0300 EDT/0700 GMT), was conditional on 66-2/3 percent of Wascana stock being tendered.
CanOxy bid C$20.50 cash per Wascana share, an offer that eclipsed a hostile bid from Talisman Energy Inc launched in February.
Talisman said last week it would not sweeten its offer, adding that the price would be too rich for Regina-based Wascana's assets, which include extensive reserves of heavy oil in Saskatchewan.
The move cleared the way for the friendly bid from CanOxy, which is now poised to enter the ranks of Canada's top three oil and gas producers in terms of output.
The deal represents the highest-priced takeover in Canada's oil patch since 1994.
